categories.label: Accounts payable
categories.description: Receive invoices, route approvals and reconcile supplier payments.

systems.name: BILL
systems.introduction: BILL brings supplier bills, customer invoices and employee spending into a finance-operations workspace. It sits alongside the accounting ledger and helps teams manage approvals and the handoff between transactions and bookkeeping.
systems.company_fit: Consider when a small or midsize finance team needs more structured payment workflows around its existing ledger.
systems.integration_context: The vendor lists accounting-system synchronization. Confirm your exact ledger edition, supported objects, sync direction and handling of rejected or duplicate records.
evaluation_questions: Which approvals occur before payment release?
How are credits, voids and sync exceptions reconciled?

systems.name: Tipalti
systems.introduction: Tipalti combines supplier onboarding, invoice processing and global payables with related procurement, expense and treasury workflows. Its role in the stack is to connect supplier-side activity with approvals, payment execution and accounting records.
use_cases: Reconcile payment results to invoice records
systems.company_fit: Consider for growing or larger organizations with cross-border suppliers or entity complexity.
systems.integration_context: Official materials list ERP connections and developer APIs. Map supplier identifiers, tax data, currencies and settlement results before selecting a connector.
evaluation_questions: Which countries and payment methods are available for the entity?
Who owns supplier-master changes and failed-payment follow-up?

systems.name: Coupa
systems.introduction: Coupa covers procure-to-pay activity, linking business purchasing with supplier invoices. For accounting teams, the important boundary is the movement from approved procurement records to the payable and its eventual posting in the ERP.
use_cases: Connect purchase orders to supplier invoices
systems.company_fit: Consider when purchasing governance spans departments, entities or a substantial supplier base.
systems.integration_context: Coupa documents invoice-to-ERP integration and several supplier submission channels. Export status and retry handling need deliberate design.
evaluation_questions: How do changes to an exported invoice reach the ledger?
Which purchasing and supplier channels are in scope?

systems.name: Ramp
systems.introduction: Ramp combines corporate-card and expense workflows with accounts payable and procurement. Finance teams can use the platform to gather spending information and approvals closer to the transaction, then connect the results to accounting.
systems.company_fit: Consider across company sizes where employee and supplier spend needs a shared operating workflow.
systems.integration_context: Ramp provides an integrations catalog and accounting-automation tools. Validate entity eligibility, ledger mappings and the exact synchronization behavior.
evaluation_questions: Are card and payment products available in the required country?
How will finance review exceptions before records are posted?

systems.name: SAP Concur
systems.introduction: SAP Concur focuses on travel, employee expenses and invoice-related spending. It brings receipts, policies and approval steps together so the finance team can work from a structured spend record rather than assembling reports after the fact.
use_cases: Prepare approved employee expenses for accounting
systems.company_fit: Consider from smaller teams to multinationals; the useful fit depends on travel volume, country coverage and policy complexity.
systems.integration_context: The vendor describes prebuilt connectors and open APIs for accounting and other business systems. Check approved-report flow and card-feed reconciliation for the selected configuration.
evaluation_questions: Which local tax and reimbursement rules are supported?
What happens when card transactions or receipts arrive late?

systems.name: HighRadius
systems.introduction: HighRadius offers receivables workflows covering credit, collections, cash application and deductions. The AR product connects customer balances and payment information so collectors and cash-application staff can work on exceptions with shared context.
use_cases: Match cash receipts and resolve deductions
systems.company_fit: Consider for midsize or enterprise teams with significant receivables volume and specialized AR responsibilities.
systems.integration_context: Official pages describe ERP-integrated AR, including SAP and NetSuite connections. Verify interfaces, write-back permissions and reconciliation rather than assuming instant synchronization.
evaluation_questions: How are ambiguous payments held for review?
Can collection and dispute histories be traced to ERP balances?

systems.name: Versapay
systems.introduction: Versapay combines receivables automation with digital invoice delivery, customer collaboration and payments. A customer-facing portal can reduce scattered invoice questions while giving the finance team a clearer view of payment and dispute activity.
systems.company_fit: Consider for B2B businesses that need a more structured customer-payment experience around an established ERP.
systems.integration_context: Versapay documents ERP connectors, file-based exchange and APIs. Confirm the supported invoice, credit and payment flows for the chosen ERP.
evaluation_questions: How do partial payments and disputed invoices synchronize?
Which payment methods and fees apply to the business?

systems.name: Stripe Billing
systems.introduction: Stripe Billing manages subscription and usage-oriented billing, invoicing and collection workflows. It is a commercial billing layer: the accounting team still needs to reconcile customer activity, settlement and any separately configured revenue-recognition process.
use_cases: Change pricing and handle failed-payment follow-up
systems.company_fit: Consider for digital businesses of different sizes; engineering capacity and billing-model complexity matter as much as headcount.
systems.integration_context: The product describes CRM and CPQ connections alongside Stripe services. Evaluate metering, webhooks, export completeness and ledger reconciliation for your architecture.
evaluation_questions: Where is billable usage measured and corrected?
How are refunds and contract changes reflected in accounting?

logo.usage_conditions: Stripe publishes a logo kit and Marks Usage Terms. The terms expressly permit accurate textual references; graphic-mark permission for this independent directory is unresolved, so the text name is used. See https://stripe.com/legal/marks.

systems.name: Chargebee
systems.introduction: Chargebee provides subscription billing and monetization tools, with RevRec available for revenue-accounting workflows. Billing operations and revenue recognition should be evaluated as separate capabilities with their own data and configuration requirements.
use_cases: Transfer billing data into configured revenue schedules
systems.company_fit: Consider for subscription businesses scaling pricing, customer lifecycle and finance operations.
systems.integration_context: Official documentation describes Chargebee-to-RevRec and ERP connections. Confirm which products are licensed and how revenue rules and journal exports are configured.
evaluation_questions: Does the selected configuration include RevRec?
Who approves allocation rules, contract modifications and journal output?

logo.usage_conditions: Official public press kit and visual-identity guidance. Use the supplied intact blue/orange primary lockup on a plain light background; preserve proportions and clear space. Do not stretch, rotate, split, add shadows or use photographic/gradient backgrounds. Trademark rights remain with Chargebee.

systems.name: Zuora
systems.introduction: Zuora links subscription and usage monetization with quote-to-cash processes, including billing, collections and revenue recognition. It can serve as a specialist revenue platform when commercial arrangements exceed a simple recurring invoice.
use_cases: Connect billing events with revenue-accounting work
systems.company_fit: Consider for larger or growing recurring-revenue businesses with dedicated billing and revenue teams.
systems.integration_context: The vendor presents Billing and Revenue as connected parts of its platform. Scope the CRM, usage source and ERP handoffs for the exact product combination.
evaluation_questions: How are amendments and usage corrections versioned?
Which reconciliations prove completeness from contract through ledger?

systems.name: BlackLine
systems.introduction: BlackLine offers a financial-close layer for account reconciliation, transaction matching and journal workflows. It brings supporting data and review status together around the ledger and also offers consolidation-related capabilities.
systems.company_fit: Consider for multi-entity or high-volume accounting teams seeking standardized close controls.
systems.integration_context: The vendor describes importing ERP, bank and other transaction data. Define population completeness, matching rules and journal approval boundaries before automation.
evaluation_questions: What evidence supports every automated match?
How are source totals reconciled and unresolved differences escalated?

systems.name: FloQast
systems.introduction: FloQast organizes the accounting close around tasks, dependencies, reconciliations and review. Its operating role is to make the work around the ledger visible across preparers, reviewers and entities.
systems.company_fit: Consider for accounting teams growing beyond spreadsheet-based close coordination.
systems.integration_context: FloQast lists ERP, bank and other application integrations. Confirm the data-refresh boundary and where supporting documents and approvals are retained.
evaluation_questions: Can reviewers trace a balance to the exact supporting version?
How does the process handle late entries after sign-off?

systems.name: OneStream
systems.introduction: OneStream combines financial consolidation and close with planning and reporting. It is useful to study as a finance platform above operational ledgers, where entity results and group-level adjustments are brought into a common model.
systems.company_fit: Consider for complex groups with dedicated consolidation and finance-systems ownership.
systems.integration_context: Implementation needs a controlled mapping from source ledgers to the group model. Treat dimensions, ownership changes and elimination rules as governed accounting configuration.
evaluation_questions: How are source-to-group mappings approved and versioned?
Can group adjustments and eliminations be traced to their origin?

systems.name: CCH Tagetik
systems.introduction: CCH Tagetik, from Wolters Kluwer, supports financial close and consolidation within a broader performance-management platform. The accounting use case centers on collecting entity data, applying group rules and producing traceable consolidated reporting.
systems.company_fit: Consider for groups with reporting complexity across entities, currencies or ownership structures.
systems.integration_context: Plan the source-ERP data model and validation steps before choosing a loading method. Verify exact connectors and modules with the vendor.
evaluation_questions: How are local-account mappings reconciled to group accounts?
Can users explain and reproduce consolidation adjustments?

systems.name: Anaplan
systems.introduction: Anaplan connects financial planning with operational models such as workforce, sales and supply chain. Finance teams use this type of platform to explore how business drivers change budgets and forecasts across departments.
systems.company_fit: Consider for organizations with interconnected planning processes and staff to govern models.
systems.integration_context: Actuals and operating drivers need a governed import from source systems. Define model dimensions, refresh timing and reconciliation to the financial record.
evaluation_questions: Who owns each planning driver and assumption?
Can users compare approved scenarios without overwriting the baseline?

systems.name: Adaptive from Workday
systems.introduction: Adaptive from Workday, also known as Workday Adaptive Planning, connects financial, workforce and operational planning. The product supports budgeting and scenario analysis so finance can relate operating choices to projected results.
systems.company_fit: Consider for growing through enterprise planning teams; model scope and administrator capacity drive fit.
systems.integration_context: The vendor describes connections to enterprise data sources. Confirm the actuals load, workforce source and reporting outputs for the selected environment.
evaluation_questions: How are planning versions and submission approvals controlled?
Which reconciliation proves actuals match the ledger?

systems.name: Pigment
systems.introduction: Pigment provides collaborative planning and financial modeling across statements and operating drivers. Its role is to connect finance assumptions with plans for functions such as headcount and sales, then make scenarios comparable.
systems.company_fit: Consider for organizations with collaborative planning needs and ownership of a shared data model.
systems.integration_context: Pigment publishes a connector catalog. Validate the source dimensions, loading cadence and controls over changes to model logic.
evaluation_questions: How are changed assumptions reviewed?
Can scenario results be reconciled back to approved source data?

systems.name: Kyriba
systems.introduction: Kyriba brings cash visibility, forecasting, payment workflows and financial-risk information into a treasury platform. It connects bank and enterprise data so treasury can work from a consolidated view of liquidity and exposures.
use_cases: Coordinate liquidity forecasts and payment controls
systems.company_fit: Consider for midsize and enterprise treasury functions with multiple banks or entities.
systems.integration_context: Kyriba documents bank, ERP and API connectivity. Confirm supported bank formats, permissions, cutoff times and reconciliation for each account.
evaluation_questions: Who can initiate, approve and release payments?
How are missing statements and stale balances identified?

systems.name: Ripple Treasury
systems.introduction: Ripple Treasury, powered by GTreasury, combines treasury management, liquidity forecasting, reconciliation and risk workflows. It is a specialist treasury layer rather than a replacement for the operating accounting ledger.
use_cases: Track treasury exposures and reconciliation exceptions
systems.company_fit: Consider for established treasury teams with cash, risk and multi-bank complexity.
systems.integration_context: The official site describes ERP integration and bank connectivity. Define the accounting handoff and independently scope any optional digital-asset capabilities.
evaluation_questions: Which modules are required for the conventional treasury scope?
How are bank records and treasury accounting reconciled?

systems.name: Avalara AvaTax
systems.introduction: Avalara supplies transaction-tax tools that connect to selling and purchasing systems. AvaTax can sit in the transaction flow for tax calculations, while related services address other parts of the tax-compliance process.
use_cases: Organize tax data across sales channels
systems.company_fit: Consider where transaction-tax jurisdictions or sales channels have outgrown manual maintenance.
systems.integration_context: Avalara publishes signed partner integrations and APIs. Confirm jurisdiction coverage, document lifecycle handling and the exact tax products included.
evaluation_questions: How are exempt transactions and returns handled?
Who verifies registrations, taxability decisions and filing responsibility?

systems.name: Vertex
systems.introduction: Vertex provides enterprise tax tools spanning determination, returns and reporting, with integration options for business systems. It is useful to evaluate where tax logic must be consistently applied to transactions across a complex technology stack.
use_cases: Prepare consistent tax data for reporting
systems.company_fit: Consider for larger or complex businesses with dedicated tax operations and multiple transaction sources.
systems.integration_context: The product portfolio includes integrations and invoicing capabilities. Confirm the particular engine, ERP version, jurisdictions and reporting modules.
evaluation_questions: How is a tax-rule change tested before use?
Can each reported amount be traced back to source transactions?

systems.name: Optro
systems.introduction: Optro, formerly AuditBoard, organizes audit, risk and compliance work. It provides a shared operating layer for risk information and assurance activity; the directory does not treat software adoption as proof that controls are effective.
systems.company_fit: Consider for organizations with dedicated internal-audit, risk or compliance teams.
systems.integration_context: Plan how evidence and issue status enter from business systems. Validate specific connectors, retention and reviewer access in a scoped evaluation.
evaluation_questions: Can evidence be tied to the tested period and version?
How are findings, remediation and retesting tracked?

systems.name: Workiva
systems.introduction: Workiva connects financial reporting with audit, risk and controls workflows. For finance, its role includes organizing report data, collaborative review and traceability across annual, interim and other external reporting outputs.
use_cases: Connect control evidence and disclosure review
systems.company_fit: Consider for organizations with formal reporting obligations or complex collaborative review cycles.
systems.integration_context: The platform describes linked data and history. Scope data feeds, document permissions and final report validation rather than assuming a connection establishes accuracy.
evaluation_questions: Who controls final disclosure and filing approval?
How are changes propagated and checked across linked reports?

systems.name: Diligent One
systems.introduction: Diligent One brings governance, risk, compliance and audit activities into a shared platform. It is relevant to accounting teams that need to connect assurance work and risk reporting with management and board oversight.
use_cases: Report control issues to oversight teams
systems.company_fit: Consider for organizations with formal governance structures and multiple assurance stakeholders.
systems.integration_context: Identify how audit populations and evidence will enter the selected modules. Confirm connector scope, access control and audit-trail retention.
evaluation_questions: Can reviewers distinguish draft evidence from approved conclusions?
How are issue ownership and overdue remediation escalated?

systems.name: Fivetran
systems.introduction: Fivetran moves data from applications, databases and other sources into analytical destinations. In a finance stack it can supply a reporting warehouse, but data movement alone does not validate accounting completeness or authorize ledger changes.
use_cases: Bring operational and accounting data into analysis
systems.company_fit: Consider for organizations with a data platform and staff responsible for financial data quality.
systems.integration_context: The vendor describes source and destination connectors. Validate table coverage, history, deleted records, refresh latency and downstream reconciliation.
evaluation_questions: Which source records are excluded or delayed?
What control reconciles warehouse results to the books?

systems.name: Boomi
systems.introduction: Boomi is an integration platform for connecting applications and data. Finance teams can use this type of layer to coordinate ERP handoffs, while keeping transformation logic, failures and permissions under explicit ownership.
systems.company_fit: Consider for organizations with several business systems and an integration owner or delivery partner.
systems.integration_context: Boomi provides application connectors and integration tooling. Select the supported connector version and design idempotency, retries and reconciliation per flow.
evaluation_questions: How are partial failures and duplicate messages handled?
Who can change a mapping that affects a financial posting?

systems.name: Celigo
systems.introduction: Celigo provides application integration through integrator.io, with prebuilt and universal connectors. A common finance pattern is moving orders and related records between commerce, CRM and ERP systems with visible error handling.
systems.company_fit: Consider for growing through enterprise businesses with recurring application-to-application workflows.
systems.integration_context: Official documentation describes connectors and iterative integration lifecycle management. Scope each business object and reconciliation step rather than assuming a template covers every exception.
evaluation_questions: How are refunds, cancellations and duplicate orders handled?
Can support staff replay failures safely and trace the outcome?

systems.name: QuickBooks Online
systems.introduction: QuickBooks Online is a core accounting product for smaller businesses, bringing bookkeeping, invoicing and financial reporting into one workspace. It is often the ledger around which specialist payment, expense or reporting tools are connected.
systems.company_fit: Consider for small businesses; verify plan limits and country-specific functionality before selection.
systems.integration_context: Evaluate bank feeds and connected applications against the required transaction detail. Set clear ownership for categorization, reconciliation and closing periods.
evaluation_questions: Does the country and plan support the required workflows?
How will external apps avoid creating duplicate transactions?

systems.name: Xero
systems.introduction: Xero brings small-business accounting tasks such as invoicing, bills and bank reconciliation into a shared cloud workspace. Its app ecosystem lets a business extend the ledger with specialist tools as operational needs develop.
systems.company_fit: Consider for small and some midsize businesses; assess entity complexity and the local product edition.
systems.integration_context: Xero advertises an app ecosystem alongside its accounting features. Confirm each app’s data ownership, posting behavior and support for local requirements.
evaluation_questions: Which functions require a separate product or plan?
How are bank-feed gaps and duplicate imports resolved?

systems.name: Oracle NetSuite
systems.introduction: Oracle NetSuite combines core financial management with business applications such as orders, inventory and commerce. Finance can evaluate it as an integrated ERP backbone, with additional capabilities for consolidation, billing and revenue.
use_cases: Connect operations to the general ledger
Manage a growing multi-entity accounting environment
systems.company_fit: Consider for growing midsize businesses and more complex groups evaluating a broader ERP.
systems.integration_context: The vendor describes linked business applications. Scope the required modules, external integrations, master data and migration controls for the intended operating model.
evaluation_questions: Which processes require additional modules or customization?
How will opening balances and migrated transactions be validated?

systems.name: Sage Intacct
systems.introduction: Sage Intacct focuses on financial management, multi-entity accounting and dimensional reporting, with extended finance capabilities. It can serve as the central ledger while operational applications connect around it.
use_cases: Coordinate finance workflows as the business grows
systems.company_fit: Consider for midsize and larger finance teams prioritizing accounting depth and multi-entity visibility.
systems.integration_context: The vendor describes an integration ecosystem and extended products. Confirm dimension mappings, entity boundaries and transaction flows for each connected application.
evaluation_questions: Are required dimensions consistently populated across sources?
How are intercompany and consolidation rules governed?

use_cases: Connect purchasing and sales with accounting
systems.company_fit: Consider for small and midsize businesses needing broader operations and accounting in one system.
systems.integration_context: Configure posting groups and financial processes carefully. Check extensions and external connections against the chosen edition, localization and upgrade path.
evaluation_questions: Which processes need an extension or implementation partner?
How are posting groups and company boundaries tested?

systems.introduction: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition connects finance with areas such as procurement, sales, manufacturing and supply chain. Its financial processes cover accounting, closing and management reporting within a broader enterprise system.
use_cases: Align operational transactions with financial accounting
Standardize a multi-function enterprise process model
